_about: The same schematic's front view: layers.py --mode image --threshold 170 at scale 4, clip 765,5,1345,200 (drawn to the plan's span scale: its wingtips 2242 px apart against the plan's 2241). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the left half (the aircraft's right: mirrored, the same). The fuselage's circle is drawn under the wing's root (the wing's upper line runs on over the top); below its widest, the main gear's legs and fairings cross its lower side (bridged). The inlets are rings round busy fan faces: their outer line's top, bottom and sides are placed (free).
